# Fowl Play regression subject

Preserved verbatim from the September 8, 2026 evaluation of `visp_luna_max_angry_bird` using build `c4b8f0951eb6b549`.

SHA-256: `117d7d53cc1e504bc477c975ded5ffc85db45f7884320dba3bbff2ef22e41e8e`.

The original run passed its three weak tests and received positive self-review. Native browser counterchecks reproduced exhausted shots being labelled victory, reversed pull-back launch, stale reset state, and primary mobile controls below the initial viewport. This file is intentionally faulty historical evidence. Browser tests compare it with narrowly corrected temporary copies. It is not an implementation template or an assertion that a structurally valid review guarantees a good game.
